description: This file implements the WidevineStorage class, which manages persistent storage of Widevine-related data, including reading/writing files, caching, and checksum verification.

classes.name: WidevineStorage
classes.description: A class that handles persistent storage of Widevine data, including reading, writing, listing, and checksum validation.

methods.name: WidevineStorage::WidevineStorage
methods.description: Constructor that loads existing data from disk and verifies or updates the checksum.

methods.name: WidevineStorage::read
methods.description: Reads a stored value by name, excluding the checksum key.

methods.name: WidevineStorage::write
methods.description: Writes a value by name, excluding the checksum key.

methods.name: WidevineStorage::exists
methods.description: Checks if a value exists by name, excluding the checksum key.

methods.name: WidevineStorage::remove
methods.description: Removes a stored value by name, excluding the checksum key.

methods.name: WidevineStorage::size
methods.description: Returns the size of the stored value by name, excluding the checksum key.

methods.name: WidevineStorage::list
methods.description: Lists all stored keys, excluding the checksum key.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads file content into a byte vector.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes byte vector content to a file.

methods.name: ReadString
methods.description: Reads a string from a byte vector with length prefix.

methods.name: WriteString
methods.description: Writes a string to a byte vector with length prefix.
